headline: Evolving the brief: prove useful repeat participation and paid value, then scale what works.
summary: Owner clarification on September 14: the original prompt is a starting point, not a fixed rulebook. The team owns judgment and can revise targets, tactics, offer and agent allocation as evidence changes. Autonomous responsibility does not require continuous agent activity. HQ should explain what we learned, what changed and what we test next; reserve owner cards for concrete prepared actions requiring business authority.

Measured baseline is incomplete. The live HQ API still returns July 14. A September 14 aggregate read of a locally configured database found 111 account rows, no registrations in the last 30 days, no upcoming published sessions in the next seven days and no recorded attended reflections. That connection is not verified as production and test/staff exclusions are unavailable. These are not 111 real users. Current production users, active supply and settled revenue remain unknown.

Initial planning scenarios are preserved for comparison: 25 new registrations by September 21; 200 base / 1,000 stretch by October 14. These are revisable assumptions, not fixed commitments or permission to buy empty growth. The dates become evidence-review checkpoints. No measured channel or verified production baseline supports a growth forecast yet. Set acquisition scale from real host capacity and compatible places; report missed assumptions and revisions openly.

Current business hypothesis: help a small real group attend something worthwhile, choose to return, and eventually make a voluntary settled payment for an implemented optional benefit at an owner-approved price. One payment would be an early signal, not proof of profitability. Existing Plus is a candidate offer that can be changed or rejected. Purchase intent is not revenue; no spending, pricing or payment activation is newly authorized.

Verified framework patch: Next/eslint-config-next 16.3.5 and matching lockfile committed as 98ac494 on studio/autonomous, now integrated into local main. Independent supervisor checks passed: clean install, all workspace typechecks, 1,190 web and 229 domain tests, lint (zero errors / 11 warnings) and production build. Root smoke confirmed landing/HQ/static delivery, signed-out discovery redirect and owner API rejection. Fresh audit: zero critical findings, 11 high and 15 moderate package findings remaining. The live service has not been deployed or verified patched.

Operating system installed: one coordinator can delegate up to three specialists; the Windows task wakes every 30 minutes and at logon. Scheduled-task execution and overlap protection were verified. Initial activation exposed registry denial and an interrupted supervisor handoff; both were reviewed, work preserved, invocation network access enabled, and transient status-reader handling tested. The first product outcome completed with root-supervised recovery; no successful unattended or 24/7 reliability claim is made. Recurring work is being resumed after the verified handoff. Computer must be awake/logged in, online and have ChatGPT usage available. Verification/auth/quota failures stop costly retries.

Reporting access is blocked: local HQ publishing/decision credentials are missing and the Vercel login is expired. This report is a local repository snapshot until authenticated API publication succeeds. The live website will continue showing the old report until that access is restored. The team continues useful local work; there is no substitute for a verified live publish.

Next decisive evidence: a real host commitment, worthwhile attendance, return and paid value. Continue useful joining-flow work and address material safety or broken-core-flow risks. Avoid building more features, content or operational machinery merely to fill agent time. Reconsider the plan after evidence changes and preserve prior assumptions in HQ. Current access, host-pilot and exact-release owner cards remain unchanged.

directions.title: Restore live HQ reporting and decision access
directions.detail: The local reporting credentials are absent and Vercel reports an invalid login. This prevents publishing new reports to live HQ and reading your saved approval responses. The agent cannot sign into your provider account for you. This local snapshot is reviewable at /hq.html; the remote HQ still has July's report.
directions.recommendation: Complete vercel login on this computer, then tell the team authentication is restored. The team can retrieve the existing scoped reporting configuration and verify an authenticated publish/readback. Alternative: provision the existing STANDUP_AGENT_SECRET for report publishing and SOCIAL_AGENT_SECRET for decision reads in the ignored .env.studio.local file through your secure environment workflow. Never paste secret values into HQ or chat. Until restored, local work and local reports continue.

directions.title: Approve a small Bucharest host-validation pilot
directions.detail: Ready packet: /operations/host-pilot-2026-09-14.html. Five organizations were checked on their official sites: Runners of Bucharest, F45 Bucharest North, Padel One, PadelMania and Bucharest Running Club. The packet contains the exact Romanian message, tailored opening lines and host/session checklist. No messages have been sent and no host is committed. This is a 14-day research pilot, not a final launch-country decision.
directions.recommendation: Approve Bucharest as the pilot hypothesis and personally send one tailored inquiry to each of the five organizations, with at most one follow-up after five business days if unanswered. Target five inquiries by day 3, two substantive conversations by day 7, one committed host and feasible session plan by day 14. A named real safety/operator contact is required before any session. Alternatives: name a city where you have a reliable local operator, or defer real outreach. Approval does not permit spending, bookings, contracts, public campaigns or agent-operated account messages.
